follows.title: Who Is He? Who Are They?

note: A1+ Unit 1 Lesson 1.9 rebuilt on 2026-11-18 under the A1+ lesson standards approved 2026-10-27 and the user's 2026-11-09 rule that every A1+ lesson follows up the A1 lesson with the same number; the user asked on 2026-11-18 to complete Unit 1 straight to Preview. A1 1.9 Who Is He? Who Are They? asks who family members are (Who is he? He is the father.). A1+ 1.9 asks about what they do and where they live, with does: Does your grandmother drink tea? Yes, she does. / Does your grandfather drink tea? No, he doesn't. / Where does your aunt live? She lives in Canada. / Who does your cousin live with? He lives with my grandparents. Luis asks and Ana answers about her family, with the facts and approved photos of 1.4 (aunt in Canada, uncle and cousin in Mexico, the cousin with the grandparents, Ana in the United States) and 1.6 (the grandmother drinks tea, the grandfather drinks coffee, the mother and the father run in the park). After does the verb has no -s (Does your aunt live...?), so the base form live is taught with it. A short answer keeps the person of the question, so its bank sets Yes against No on that person. No new photos.

lesson.title: 1.9 Does your family...?
lesson.unit_outcome: Describe people and family, say what people do every day and how often, and ask about other people’s habits.
lesson.goal: Ask about someone's family with does and answer with a short answer (Does your grandmother drink tea? Yes, she does.), and ask where and who with does (Where does your aunt live? Who does your cousin live with?).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 1.9 Who Is He? Who Are They?: A1 asks who family members are (Who is he? He is the father.); A1+ 1.9 asks what they do and where they live, with does. The one new grammar relationship is the question with does + the base verb, and its short answer: Does your grandmother drink tea? Yes, she does. / No, he doesn't. Where does and Who does put a question word before it (Where does your aunt live? Who does your cousin live with?). After does the verb loses its -s, as after 1.8's doesn't.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 1.9 Who; A1 4.3 Where; A1 4.8 Do you...? and Yes, I do.; A1 5.3 drink and tea; A1 4.8 run; A1+ 1.4 aunt, uncle, cousin, lives in, with; A1+ 1.6 the grandparents' tea and coffee and the parents running in the park; A1+ 1.8 doesn't.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Ask with does and a falling-rising question tone, keep the verb without -s after does (Does she drink...?), and answer with a short answer that keeps the person (Yes, she does. / No, he doesn't.). Do not require native-like speed.
